segments.name: Unified business
segments.description: Designs and sells hardware products plus cloud-based software and cybersecurity solutions for drone and robotics markets globally.
segments.evidence: The Company concluded that its unified business is conducted globally and accordingly represents one operating segment.

revenueModel.text: Customers pay the company for goods sold, with revenue recognized when the customer obtains control of the goods, generally at delivery.
revenueModel.evidence: Revenue from the sale of goods is recognised at the point in time when the customer obtains control of the goods, which is generally at the time of delivery.
